name: bluesky_hydrate_post
description: Open a single Bluesky post by its ref (from bluesky_timeline) in isolation, with its image shown directly to you when present. Use before replying to a post that has an image or quotes another post, so you react to what is actually there.

inputs.name: post_ref
inputs.description: The [bN] ref of the post to open (e.g. 'b1').

outputs.description: The post's full text, image alt, and an [emi_image: ...] marker when it has an image.
